merge.gates: All four required gates green on the exact head a1eafe947848 before the merge. Merged through the protected process; nothing dispatched, bypassed or inherited.
merge.two_gate_failures_fixed_not_worked_aroun: The first attempt failed phase3-full-software-gate and phase5-post-stay-transfer-gate. Phase 3: 0079 changes the schema, so the factory-clean production baseline no longer agreed with the upgrade path's end state -- regenerated, and re-verified at 9500 catalog facts IDENTICAL to the upgrade path. Phase 5: that gate runs ./cmd/edged with NO -run filter, so the new isolation suite executed against a chain that stopped at 0071 and failed on a missing relation. Chain extended to 0079 and its base-table count corrected from 77 to 86. Both were reproduced and fixed locally with the same harnesses CI runs.

values_preserved.after: One row keyed to the 'Protel' interface: 500 / 30000 / 60 / 900 / 3 at config_version 2. Identical.
values_preserved.is_default_false: The accessor reports is_default=false -- the operator's configured row survived AS CONFIGURED. Had the migration reset it, the row would have vanished and the accessor would have answered with defaults and is_default=true. Those two states carry the same five numbers and opposite meanings, which is why this is checked rather than the numbers alone.
values_preserved.invariants: Primary key has three columns; zero site-wide leftovers; the two pre-existing audit rows are untouched and keep their NULL interface, because a NULL interface is exactly what they were.
values_preserved.old_accessor_removed: Zero two-argument pms_connection_settings_get definitions remain. A caller anybody forgot to update now fails loudly instead of silently reading some other connection's bounds.

served_ui_verified.present: 'These apply to this connection only', 'keeps its own values and is unaffected', 'could not be read just now', 'fault to report', 'nobody has changed this one'.
served_ui_verified.removed: 'apply to the whole site' and 'changing a value here changes it for all of them' are gone from the served bundle. That sentence was accurate about a storage model that no longer exists; left behind it would have been worse than the original defect -- a false warning discouraging an operator from tuning a link they own.

what_the_live_probe_could_not_prove.claim_not_made: The removal of the old site-wide PUT /pms-roster-reconciliation/connection-settings route is NOT evidenced by live probing. Authentication runs before routing on this service, so a deliberately nonexistent path returns 401 exactly as the removed one does -- the probe is uninformative and is recorded as such rather than presented as proof.
what_the_live_probe_could_not_prove.what_does_evidence_it: The merged source, and the Phase-5 gate which compiles and runs every cmd/edged suite against a real database.
